annotations.title: Tell us what data you needed and did not find

description: Name the dataset, field, company or analysis you wanted and why. Free, needs no key, never metered, and read every week: the most-asked-for data is what gets added next. Do not send personal data (emails and phone numbers are removed). GET the same URL for the field list. At most 10 requests per address per day. (POST https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/request-data — free; needs no credentials)

kind.description: What sort of gap: a dataset, a field, an analysis, a company we do not cover, a bug.

ticker.description: The company it was about, if any.

tool.description: The tool you were using when you hit the gap.

want.description: What you wanted, e.g. "Quarterly segment revenue for NVDA".

why.description: The task you were doing, so we build the right thing.
